decisions.evidence: Across all six neighbors, the repeated and most chemically convincing pattern is the presence of an alkyl chloride in the query, often together with an alkene, and those features outweigh the smaller size, lower surface area, or modest logP changes. The non-mutagenic analogs do not remove the reactive halide alert, and the mutagenic neighbors reinforce that this scaffold is better classified as option (B): is mutagenic.
